title: Ambient etale scalar mate package
statement: The ordinary etale proper/open scalar mate package EtaleMates exists for every finite coefficient map and compactification under the hypotheses of finite scalar maps.

proof.text: Construct the proper/open comparison, its adjoint mate, projection normalization and shift compatibilities on the ordinary etale categories.

lean.statement: theorem finiteScalarMapsEtale_exists (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (_hl : l ≠ D.p) (E L : Type u) [Field E] [Field L] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [Algebra (Padic l) L] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) L] (n m : ℕ) (a : Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1) →+* Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l L (m + 1)) {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (.of D.k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of D.k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spec (.of D.k))] [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f] (c : Compactification f) : Nonempty (EtaleMates (RingHom.ulift.{u + 1, u + 1} a) c)
